name: run_program_setup_and_cleanup
description: Program entry sequence that calls the system library indirectly to open and check a structure, makes a series of setup calls, sets a saved state word, and finishes with a cleanup call.

name: await_messages_and_free_copperlists
description: Opens the dos, graphics and intuition libraries, waits on and replies to messages on a port, and frees the copper lists and view port data, with the DMA control register written to enable channels.

name: retry_file_open_until_timeout
description: Repeatedly calls a dos routine that tries to open a file, waiting in a counted busy loop between attempts and giving up after a fixed time window. On failure it runs the standard cleanup call sequence and returns its result.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately with no work; it is an empty stub called from a single place.

name: check_artwork_load_result
description: Calls a routine and checks whether it succeeded; on success it makes three more calls and returns. On failure it runs the standard library call sequence and restores a saved value, and it refers to the artwork screen file on the floppy disk.

name: run_three_subroutines_in_order
description: Calls three other routines one after another and returns, adding no logic of its own. Two routines call it.

name: generate_pseudo_random_value
description: Multiplies a stored 16-bit state word by a fixed constant, adds one and saves it back, then returns part of the product shifted by the requested amount. Its 25 callers use it as a pseudo-random number generator.

name: do_nothing_and_return
description: Contains no instructions beyond returning, and only one routine calls it.

name: save_state_and_install_handlers
description: Saves four state words, then when a flag is clear stores four handler addresses into the interrupt and exception vectors and calls the system vector setup routine for each. It also reads values through the library base and calls the remaining routine.

name: disable_hardware_and_restore_state
description: Removes interrupt handlers through the system library, writes to the interrupt-enable and DMA control registers to switch them off, makes six more library calls, and writes back four saved state words. It undoes the work of the routine that installs the handlers.

name: return_without_action
description: Only returns; it is an unreached stub in a gap between other routines.

name: accumulate_mouse_movement_and_buttons
description: Reads the mouse movement register, works out the change on each axis since the last call and adds it to running totals. It sets a status bit from the fire button line and a change flag when the position has moved, then calls further routines based on a counter.

name: return_without_action
description: Only returns; it is an unreached stub in a gap between other routines.

name: decode_keyboard_serial_byte
description: Reads the keyboard serial data byte, inverts and rotates it to get the key code, and handles two special codes by setting or clearing flag bits. Other key-down codes are translated through a character table and stored in a circular buffer that wraps at its size.

name: update_status_bit_one
description: Sets bit one of a shared status word when the top bit of the value passed in is clear, and clears it when that top bit is set.

name: update_status_bit_zero
description: Sets bit zero of a shared status word when the top bit of the value passed in is clear, and clears it when that top bit is set.

name: merge_bits_into_status_word
description: ORs the 16-bit value passed in the D1 register into a shared status word, so any bits set in the argument become set in the status word.

name: store_table_key_in_buffer
description: When the top bit of the input is clear, looks up a table entry from the input value, adjusts it by one if a shared flag is set, stores it in the circular key buffer and advances the write index, wrapping at the buffer size.

name: test_key_buffer_has_data
description: Returns zero when the read and write positions of the circular key buffer are equal, meaning it is empty, and minus one otherwise to report that data is waiting.

name: wait_then_read_key
description: Waits until the circular key buffer has data, then returns the entry at the read position and advances that position, wrapping at the buffer size. Fifteen routines call it.

name: rearm_interrupt_bit_seven
description: Writes bit seven to the interrupt control registers twice. If its nesting counter is above zero it decrements the counter and writes the bit back with the enable flag set; otherwise it resets the counter to minus one and writes one to the request register.

name: decrement_audio_channel_zero_count
description: Decrements the nesting counter for audio channel zero and writes value one to the DMA control register with the enable flag clear, which switches that channel's DMA off.

name: rearm_interrupt_bit_eight
description: Writes bit eight to the interrupt control registers twice, then either decrements its nesting counter and re-enables the bit, or resets the counter to minus one and writes two to the request register.

name: decrement_audio_channel_one_count
description: Decrements the nesting counter for audio channel one and writes value two to the DMA control register with the enable flag clear, which switches that channel's DMA off.

name: rearm_interrupt_bit_nine
description: Writes bit nine to the interrupt control registers twice, then either decrements its nesting counter and re-enables the bit, or resets the counter to minus one and writes four to the request register.

name: decrement_audio_channel_two_count
description: Decrements the nesting counter for audio channel two and writes value four to the DMA control register with the enable flag clear, which switches that channel's DMA off.

name: rearm_interrupt_bit_ten
description: Writes bit ten to the interrupt control registers twice, then either decrements its nesting counter and re-enables the bit, or resets the counter to minus one and writes eight to the request register.

name: decrement_audio_channel_three_count
description: Decrements the nesting counter for audio channel three and writes value eight to the DMA control register with the enable flag clear, which switches that channel's DMA off.

name: step_audio_volume_envelope
description: For each of four audio channels whose bit is set in a flag word, copies the shared volume level into that channel's volume register. It then moves the shared level up or down one step by the direction value, clearing the direction when the level reaches its lower or upper limit.

name: accumulate_elapsed_timer_ticks
description: Reads a timer register, works out how far it has moved since the previous reading allowing for 16-bit wrap-around, and adds four times that difference to a running total.

name: allocate_aligned_block_from_pool
description: Rounds the requested size up to an even number and, if the block fits before the pool limit, advances the pool pointer and returns the block's start address. Otherwise it returns minus one.

name: poll_with_countdown_timeout
description: Polls a library check in a countdown loop, starting the countdown from a value chosen by a flag and lowering it by a thousand per attempt. If the check never succeeds before the countdown goes negative, it runs the standard cleanup calls and returns the last result.

name: initialise_display_structures
description: Picks the base address for display memory, gets a color map from the graphics library, and runs a long chain of setup calls that fill in display structure pointers. It returns minus one if any call fails, and on success clears several counters and returns the end of the reserved block.

name: load_pit_background_once
description: When its state flag is clear, calls a routine tied to the pit background artwork file on the floppy disk, then clears a companion state word and sets the flag.

name: load_mirror_artwork_once
description: When its state flag is clear, calls a routine tied to the mirror artwork file on the floppy disk, then sets the flag and clears a companion state word.

name: append_twelve_byte_record_entry
description: Writes a twelve-byte entry into a table at the index given in the first argument, storing a running offset and the second argument. It then calls a routine for a size: if the size is positive and the new running offset stays under a fixed limit, it stores half the size and returns it, otherwise it returns minus one.

name: always_return_minus_one
description: Always returns minus one with no other work; it is an unreached gap routine.

name: run_sound_data_loading
description: Calls two routines that work with the sounds data file on the floppy disk, and calls two more only when a flag word is nonzero.

name: load_second_sound_file
description: When a flag word is nonzero, calls two routines tied to the second sounds data file on the floppy disk. Otherwise it does nothing.

name: add_base_to_table_entries
description: Calls one routine, then loops thirty times over a table of three-word records, adding the table base address to the first word of each record. The table is the one referenced by the third sounds data file.

name: add_argument_base_to_table
description: Loops thirty times over a table of three-word records, adding the table base address passed in to the first word of each record.

name: flip_buffer_top_bits
description: Gets a count from one routine, subtracts 128 from each byte of a buffer for that many bytes, which flips each byte's top bit, and then calls one more routine. It sits in a gap between code sections.

name: fetch_value_pair_and_finish
description: Calls a library routine that returns a pair of values. If its high half is zero it returns minus one; otherwise it stores that half, calls the library routine three more times, fetches one more value, runs two cleanup calls and returns the pair.

name: read_values_and_close_file
description: Calls a dos routine that returns a pair of values and, if the high half is nonzero, stores it and makes three further calls through the dos table followed by two cleanup calls. It returns two of the results.

name: return_without_action
description: Only returns; it is an empty stub called from one place.

name: read_demo_lap_data
description: Opens the demo lap data file on the floppy disk through a routine and, on success, makes two read calls and a close call before returning zero. It returns minus one if the open fails.

name: read_high_scores_table
description: Opens the high score table file through a routine and, on success, reads from it twice and closes it, then runs one further routine. It returns zero on success and minus one if the open fails.

name: write_high_scores_table
description: Opens the high score table file through a routine and, on success, writes to it. When a marker byte in the referenced buffer is an asterisk it writes twice more, then closes the file and runs one further routine. It returns zero on success and minus one if the open fails.

name: xor_scramble_buffer
description: XORs each of 220 bytes in a fixed buffer with one fixed key value, scrambling or unscrambling the buffer in place.

name: read_twelve_chunks_and_close
description: Opens a data file through a routine and, on success, makes twelve read calls and a close call, returning zero. It returns minus one if the open fails.

name: read_nine_chunks_and_close
description: Opens a data file through a routine and, on success, makes nine read calls and a close call, returning zero. It returns minus one if the open fails.

name: read_table_entries_from_file
description: Opens a data file through a routine and, on success, reads one value per table entry, adding a stored offset to each entry, then makes further reads in two more passes before closing. On failure it clears the entry count and returns minus one.

name: copy_name_then_store_result
description: Copies eight characters from a fixed-size record into a fixed buffer, changing each space to a zero byte, then calls a routine and stores its result in the table slot chosen by the second argument. The text it refers to is the bob sprite folder on the floppy disk.

name: store_result_in_table_slot
description: Calls a routine and, when the index argument is zero or positive, stores its result in the table slot for that index.

name: copy_name_and_call_routine
description: Copies eight characters from a fixed-size record into a fixed buffer, changing each space to a zero byte, then calls one routine and returns, storing nothing.

name: load_bob_artwork_library
description: Loads the bob artwork library from the floppy disk through a long chain of routines, each run only if the previous one succeeded. The library file is closed through the dos table at the end.

name: load_top_racer_sprites
description: Sets the allocation offset from two stored positions, then calls one routine that loads the top racer sprite files and another that finishes the load. It returns the first result.

name: load_inset_sprite_image
description: Sets the allocation offset from two stored positions and stores the result of a loader call for the inset sprite file.

name: load_tv_backdrop_sprites
description: Saves two stored positions, sets a new allocation position and size depending on a flag, calls two loaders whose results are stored for the TV backdrop, banner and TV sprite files, then restores the saved positions.

name: load_second_bob_artwork_library
description: Sets the allocation offset from a stored position and loads the second bob artwork library through a chain of up to nine routines, each checked for failure. On success it restores the saved offset and closes the file; on failure it closes the file and returns minus one.

name: dispatch_command_codes_loop
description: Loops reading command codes from a routine until a negative value appears. Code 12345 saves a 16-bit field, runs one routine and restores the field; other codes call a pair of routines, one more when the code is two to four, and a final routine.

name: fill_sixty_four_entry_table
description: Fills a table of four rows by sixteen entries. Each entry is a row offset plus a 16-bit value read from a source table with a stride of twenty-four bytes.

name: store_arguments_and_call
description: Saves two register arguments into shared globals, then calls one routine and returns.

name: read_and_close_when_opened
description: Saves two register arguments, then calls a routine. On success it stores the handle, reads a result through a second routine, closes the file and returns that result. On failure it runs one more routine and returns zero.

name: load_bitmap_planes_from_file
description: Reads a bitmap header through the dos library and checks its type code, then reads a chunk of data, converts packed bytes into 16-bit words and sets up the bitmap planes with the graphics library. At the end it ORs four bitplanes together into the destination plane row by row.

name: or_merge_bitplanes_into_destination
description: If a bitmap pointer is set, ORs the four source bitplanes word by word into the destination plane, over a count derived from the bitmap dimensions. It does nothing when the pointer is null.

name: find_iff_chunk_signature
description: Compares a four-byte input with a table of six four-character IFF chunk names, FORM, ILBM, BMHD, CMAP, GRAB and BODY, returning the index of the first match or minus one if none matches.

name: repeat_four_calls_per_row
description: Loops over a count, calling four routines on each pass and a fifth when the global mode value is above four, until the count runs out.

name: unpack_packbits_bitplane_data
description: Decodes run-length packed data in the PackBits style: a negative control byte repeats the next byte, a positive one copies that many literal bytes, and a control value of minus 128 is skipped. When a flag is clear it instead copies raw 16-bit words.

name: select_cockpit_artwork_load
description: When the state word is zero it calls one routine and returns. Otherwise it sets a byte flag to one and calls a routine. The text it refers to is the cockpit artwork file.

name: advance_cockpit_offset_after_load
description: Calls one routine that loads the cockpit artwork, then adds 116 to a stored offset.

name: fill_paired_buffers_with_values
description: Writes a stream of values from a routine into two buffers at once, byte by byte over a 16-bit count, then enters an endless loop writing words into the same buffers.

name: compute_four_bitplane_addresses
description: Initialises a bitmap through the graphics library and, when the given plane size is positive, stores four bitplane start addresses in the structure, each one plane size further on than the last. It returns zero on success and minus one when the size is not positive.

name: build_and_load_display_view
description: Sets up the graphics display by obtaining a color map, initialising the rastport, view and viewport structures, making and merging the copper list and loading the view. It sets the display width to 320, then stores a height of 200 and a size of 8000 before returning.

name: rebuild_viewport_and_load_view
description: Rebuilds the display viewport: it obtains a color map when none exists, sets the width to 320 and the display mode to five, initialises the viewport and view structures, makes and merges the copper list and loads the view.

name: reload_view_with_mode_five
description: Sets a state word to minus one and the display mode to five, then calls the viewport, copper merge and load-view library calls. It sits in a gap between code sections.

name: load_view_with_mode_four
description: Sets the display mode to four and calls the graphics library to load the view.

name: update_delay_and_flip_pages
description: Reads a timer, works out the time elapsed since the last call and clamps it between eight and fifty as the frame delay. It then toggles the buffer-set flag, swaps the saved pointer pairs and calls one more routine.

name: reload_view_and_clear_flag
description: Calls one routine, then calls the graphics library to reload the view, and clears a state byte to zero.

name: wait_then_free_copperlists
description: Copies four saved pointer values into working fields, waits for the display to reach the bottom of the viewport, then loads the view and frees the copper list and viewport copies. Four further calls follow at the end.

name: save_copper_pointers_set_one
description: Resets two pointer pairs, makes and merges the viewport copper list through the graphics library, then saves the resulting pointers into the first saved set.

name: save_copper_pointers_set_two
description: Resets two pointer pairs, makes and merges the viewport copper list through the graphics library, then saves the resulting pointers into the second saved set.

name: replace_copperlists_after_wait
description: Remembers two copper pointers, makes and merges a new viewport copper list, loads the view and waits for the bottom of the viewport. It then frees the previous copper lists for any pointer that has changed.

name: run_game_input_dispatch_loop
description: Runs the main input loop: each pass it advances timing counters, reads a key or control code and dispatches on it. Several keys call routines and set state fields, the space key and others trigger a shared action, and the q key ends the loop with minus one when a condition holds.

name: clear_flag_run_four_steps
description: Clears a flag word and then calls four routines in order.

name: forward_arguments_and_return_pair
description: Calls one routine, then calls another routine, and returns the two argument registers it was given as a pair.

name: sum_bytes_over_code_range
description: Adds up every byte from a fixed start address to a fixed end address and returns the total, a simple checksum over a region of the program.

name: store_result_in_state_slot
description: Calls a routine and stores its result in a fixed field of the shared state block.

name: run_input_loop_until_changed
description: Calls a routine and returns at once if its value matches a stored field. Otherwise it runs the same key dispatch loop as the main input routine, which ends on the q key.

name: return_without_action
description: Only returns; it is an unreached gap routine.

name: store_fixed_constant_value
description: Stores one fixed 32-bit constant into a shared global location and returns, with no other work.

name: verify_original_disk_is_inserted
description: Clears a status word, reads a disk identifier and compares it with a stored value. On a mismatch it retries after two routines, and if it still does not match it sets the status word to minus one. The text it refers to asks the player to insert the original or back-up disk in drive A.

name: call_two_subroutines_in_order
description: Calls two other routines in order and returns, adding no logic of its own.

name: run_timed_action_when_due
description: When a count is positive, a flag is set and a busy flag is clear, it runs one routine if at least forty timer ticks have passed since the last run or a force flag is set. It records the time, clears the force flag and sets the busy flag around that call.

name: run_single_subroutine
description: Calls one other routine and returns, adding no logic of its own.

name: copy_table_word_into_field
description: Looks up a 16-bit word in a table using a stored index, doubled to a byte offset, and copies it into a fixed field of the shared state block.

name: forward_to_one_routine
description: Calls one other routine and returns, adding no logic of its own.

name: copy_indexed_table_word
description: Looks up a 16-bit word in a table using a stored index, doubled to a byte offset, and copies it into a fixed field of the shared state block.

name: store_three_offset_values
description: Calls a routine three times and stores each result, lowered by 256, into three consecutive fields of the shared state block. It sits in a gap between code sections.

name: scale_pseudo_random_value
description: Advances a 16-bit pseudo-random state word with a fixed multiplier and increment, then returns the upper 16 bits of the masked state multiplied by the argument and by two. Fifteen routines call it.

name: draw_offset_object_when_idle
description: When a flag is clear, clamps a stored offset to between minus five and five and passes it, with fixed size and position values, to a graphics drawing call. It then makes one more call.

name: run_routine_with_swapped_pointers
description: Temporarily swaps the working pointer pair with the alternate pair, calls one routine, then restores the original pointers.

name: blit_fixed_rectangle_region
description: Makes one routine call, then calls the graphics bit-map blit stub with fixed width, height and position values to copy a rectangle, and calls it again.

name: draw_linked_object_list
description: Sets a timing value, and when a flag is clear walks a linked list of objects from a stored head, calling a drawing routine with fixed screen values for each node. It then resets the timing value.

name: draw_repeated_items_with_swap
description: Temporarily points the working pointer at a stored address and draws a series of items, one call per step of a stored count, then restores the pointer.

name: return_without_action
description: Only returns; it is an empty stub.

name: return_without_action
description: Only returns; it is an unreached gap routine.

name: compute_integer_square_root
description: Returns the integer square root of the input value, found by a bit-by-bit search over squares. Negative inputs leave the result at zero.

name: return_without_action
description: Only returns; it is an unreached gap routine.

name: send_serial_byte
description: Waits until the serial transmit busy flag is clear, sets it, then writes the low byte of the argument with the stop bit set to the serial data register.

name: enable_serial_transmit_interrupt
description: Clears the serial busy flag, writes one to the interrupt request register to clear the transmit interrupt, then sets the transmit enable bit in the interrupt enable register.

name: initialise_serial_port
description: Sets the serial period register to a fixed value, clears the serial receive and transmit state fields, then enables the receive and transmit interrupts in the interrupt enable register.

name: handle_serial_receive_interrupt
description: Serial receive interrupt handler. It acknowledges the receive interrupt and reads the received byte. While a receive mode flag is clear it appends the byte to an eighty-byte circular buffer, otherwise it maps the byte through a table to a command and starts a block of the stated length, then re-enables the interrupt.

name: store_serial_value_and_reenable
description: Stores its 16-bit argument in a serial state field, re-enables the serial receive interrupt and returns the argument.

name: classify_serial_command_byte
description: Maps a received serial byte through a 32-entry table, offset by forty-two. A zero entry sets one command flag, a positive entry stores its value and sets a second flag, and any other byte clears the flags and sets a third. It then re-enables the serial receive interrupt.

name: reset_serial_command_flags
description: Clears the serial command flags, sets a completion flag, then re-enables the serial receive interrupt.

name: store_serial_byte_in_buffer
description: Stores the current serial byte in an eighty-byte circular buffer, advancing the write index with wrap-around, then re-enables the serial receive interrupt.

name: test_serial_buffer_has_data
description: Returns zero when the read and write positions of the serial buffer match, meaning it is empty, and minus one when data is waiting.

name: wait_and_read_serial_byte
description: Waits until the serial buffer has data, returns the byte at the read position and advances the read index with wrap-around over eighty bytes.

name: service_serial_command_flags
description: When an enable flag is set, handles a pending completion flag by clearing it and returning. Otherwise it handles a pending command flag by calling up to two routines and then clearing the command flag.

name: parse_next_script_command
description: Reads a command code from the input stream with a timeout counter, then copies the following bytes into a buffer. It dispatches on the code: some codes copy stored values into working fields and return, others set pointer, timing or state fields, and a timeout returns early.

name: poll_up_to_forty_times
description: Calls a routine up to forty times, stopping early when it returns zero, and calls a second routine after each nonzero result.

name: send_encoded_bytes_over_serial
description: Clears the serial busy flag, encodes the first byte of the buffer by adding forty-two, then sends the buffer's bytes one at a time, waiting for the busy flag to clear between them. When a sync flag is set it calls two routines afterwards.

name: receive_bytes_until_deadline
description: Sets a deadline from a stored offset plus the timer, then repeatedly calls a routine and stores each result byte in a buffer until the timer passes the deadline or a stop state is reached. Between reads it polls for up to eighty timer ticks.

name: set_mode_four_and_run
description: Sets a shared mode byte to four and calls one routine.

name: dispatch_state_byte_actions
description: Dispatches on a state byte: state two returns at once, state three starts a timed sequence and clears a wait flag, state fifteen copies a ten-entry block into two buffers, and the other states copy stored values into display fields before returning the state.

name: set_mode_and_copy_fields
description: Sets a mode byte to one, or to eleven when either of two flags is set, copies several stored fields into the shared mode block and calls one routine.

name: wait_for_state_twenty_four
description: Saves and clears a word, sets the mode to eight and calls a routine, then polls for up to eight hundred timer ticks until the state byte reads twenty-four. It restores the saved word before returning the last state.

name: set_mode_twenty_six
description: Saves and clears a word, loads a pointer value and two stored values into the mode block, sets the mode byte to twenty-six and sets a timer field to 2400. It calls a routine and then restores the saved word.

name: copy_credits_block_when_flagged
description: When a flag word is negative, copies a ten-byte block from a fixed source into a fixed buffer. The referenced text is a list of people's names, so the block holds credits data.

name: toggle_playback_state
description: When a flag is set it sets the mode to twenty-nine, clears a field, calls routines and clears the flag, running three more routines when another field is zero. Otherwise it runs a sequence of routine calls, and when the result is non-negative it sets the flag, clears a timer field and runs a final routine.

name: read_name_entry_until_period
description: Reads input characters, waiting up to a thousand ticks for each, until a period arrives. When the state byte reaches sixteen it copies a ten-byte block into a name buffer, skipping zero bytes, sets display modes and returns the stored value, or minus one on timeout.

name: wait_twelve_frames
description: Waits for twelve display frames by calling the graphics library's vertical-blank wait twelve times.

name: return_without_action
description: Only returns; it is an unreached gap routine.

name: compute_clamped_sixty_offset
description: Takes the absolute value of a stored field shifted right by eight, returns sixty minus that value, or zero when it exceeds sixty, and calls one routine first.

name: update_object_motion_and_collisions
description: Updates one moving object each frame: it applies its velocity to its position, checks it against the other objects in the list for close contact by summing absolute distances, and on contact reverses or adds to its motion. It then copies the matching block of position data into the output table.

name: initialise_object_random_position
description: When an object's active field is zero, marks it active, sets its speed and timing fields, and gives it three position offsets from pseudo-random values, each reduced by sixty-four.

name: initialise_object_fixed_position
description: When an object's active field is zero, marks it active, sets its speed and timing fields, and sets its first position field to minus eighty while clearing the other two.

name: set_object_velocity_from_flags
description: Sets the object's timing and speed fields, then sets its two velocity values for each axis, negating them according to the low two bits of a direction word.

name: initialise_random_scatter_position
description: When an object's active field is zero, clears its counters and marks it active, then gives three of its position fields a pseudo-random offset of minus 255 and sets a fourth field from another random value adjusted to a small signed number.

name: advance_status_timers
description: Advances two countdown counters by three and seven on each pass and sets status bits when each reaches a limit taken from a stored value. It saves the status word back and then makes two routine calls.

name: initialise_object_record
description: Sets an object's marker to minus one and its counter to zero, makes two routine calls and stores the record pointer as the current object.

name: project_point_into_screen_arrays
description: Projects one point: it looks up two table values, scales them by multiplying and dividing by a fixed divisor, adds stored origin offsets and stores the resulting coordinates into two output arrays.

name: initialise_point_tables
description: When its flag is clear, sets the flag and stores a starting value in two fields. It then fills three coordinate tables per entry with values from a routine reduced by sixty-three, writes fixed values into three further arrays and offsets another table by twenty-three.

name: update_particle_positions
description: Advances a set of particles: each one with a positive life counter adds its velocity to its position, has a downward pull applied to its vertical velocity and counts its life down. Live particles are projected onto the screen with a scale from their depth and drawn through a routine, and the count is cleared when none remain.

name: spawn_particles_into_free_slots
description: Scans up to eight hundred particle slots and, for each free one, fills in its position, velocity and life from routine values. It stops after two hundred spawns and records the highest slot used.

name: choose_particle_colour
description: Calls two routines and sets the particle colour byte from one of the two results, depending on whether a flag field is zero.

name: age_and_move_particles
description: Ages each active particle: when its counter is positive it adds velocity to its position and decrements the counter, and it updates the active count. It also calls routines to draw or respawn particles when a flag allows.

name: reset_particle_table
description: Marks all five hundred particle slots as free, clears the particle count and its high-water mark, and sets a timer to fire three thousand ticks from now.

name: wait_four_frames
description: Waits for four display frames by calling the vertical-blank wait four times.

name: run_timed_frame_sequence
description: Runs a sequence of frames in which each step moves several counters towards their limits, runs display routines and waits for the blitter. It sets a table to minus one before and after, and returns early when a poll finds a nonzero result.

name: reset_motion_fields_to_defaults
description: Sets a block of about thirty motion fields to defaults: most become zero, while the scale fields become a fixed value of 16384.

name: rotate_matrix_pair_and_store
description: Stores two input values, copies a block of eight matrix words into a working area, computes a rotation of the matrix using fixed-point products of the inputs, and copies the eight-word result back over the matrix block.

name: rotate_matrix_pair_negated
description: Stores two input values and computes a rotated copy of the matrix block in which one input is negated for half of the terms. It copies the eight-word result back over the matrix block.

name: rotate_matrix_pair_alternate
description: Stores two input values and computes a second rotation of the matrix block using the opposite cross terms, then copies the eight-word result back over the matrix block.

name: select_contact_surface_plane
description: Checks four surface planes of an object in turn against a point, using a dot product and an offset. It selects the first plane whose value is within ninety-nine of zero and returns its index with the value, or minus one when every plane is farther away.

name: compute_collision_response_velocity
description: Works out the offset between the object and a reference point, projects it onto a surface normal and scales the resulting velocity by a stored factor, storing three velocity components. A second pass with averaged normals adds a further correction to the same components.

name: classify_point_against_planes
description: Tests a point against four plane values in turn and returns the index of the first plane whose value is within ninety-nine. It also returns minus one as a flag when that value is below a large negative limit, and minus one when every plane is farther away.

name: run_timed_wait_for_input
description: When a set of status fields is clear, sets a deadline 2600 ticks ahead and, depending on the sign of a stored value, waits in a loop until the deadline passes or an event arrives. It then clears a status byte and, when a value is set, marks a flag.

name: reset_shared_state_fields
description: Resets a large block of shared state to fixed defaults, clearing several tables and entry arrays, copying stored pointers and values into working fields, and computing position values from a table indexed by a stored value. It finishes with several routine calls and conditional setup.

name: initialise_object_state_block
description: Sets an object's status words, counters and limits to defaults, zeroes its entry tables and copies stored values into place. It computes a position from a table indexed by the object's state and calls routines to finish, including a branch that runs more routines.

name: run_routines_with_buffer_pointer
description: Sets the working buffer pointer from a stored address, calls one routine, points it back at the main buffer and then makes several further routine calls.

name: run_setup_routines_and_timer
description: Calls seven routines, records the current timer value in a deadline field, then calls two more routines.

name: compute_position_index_fields
description: Computes a position index from a stored table entry and an offset, wrapping it when it passes a limit, and stores it with several scaled copies of the offset and table values into shared fields.

name: set_table_values_by_flag
description: Sets two size fields and four entries of a table to fixed values, choosing one of two sets of constants depending on whether a flag word is negative, and sets three more shared fields to match.

name: run_paired_routines_when_flagged
description: When a flag word is negative, saves the working pointer pair, makes four routine calls with fixed arguments while pointing the working pair at a stored address, then restores the saved pair.

name: reset_text_buffer_and_timers
description: Blanks six characters of the on-screen text fields with spaces, increments a counter and resets several status fields to defaults. It also sets a timer 180000 ticks ahead.

name: build_object_list_from_table
description: Resets timing and count fields, then builds a list of records from a stored table. Each record gets its index, a time value and a link to the next record, and each one's sorting value is set to a large initial value.

name: reset_object_list_timings
description: Walks the linked list of records and resets each one's index, time offset and status fields. It takes values from the stored table and adds a stored offset to negative times, then clears a control field.

name: run_main_event_loop
description: Runs the main event loop: each pass it updates timers and counters, reads a key code and dispatches on it. Tab toggles a mode and calls routines, letters a, p, l, t and others each call their own handlers, b starts a timed action with a capped duration, and r counts a value down before toggling. Some keys are ignored while a status bit is set.

name: update_standings_text_display
description: Clears per-run status fields, then fills the on-screen text fields with entries from the linked list of standings, writing each position's label and characters from a table, and sets a timer for the display. The referenced text holds headings such as race results and qualifying.

name: record_best_entry_for_slot
description: Scans the linked list for the entry with the smallest time value. If it beats the stored best for the current slot, copies a ten-byte name from the table entry into the slot's record and marks the result as changed.

name: store_entry_name_if_faster
description: Compares the current time with the stored best for the current slot and, when it is faster, copies a ten-byte name into the slot's record and marks the result as changed. The referenced text is a list of people's names.

name: return_without_action
description: Its decompiled body is only a return, so no behaviour is recovered for this routine.

name: run_three_calls_by_state
description: When two state fields are clear, makes three routine calls, choosing between two groups of calls according to a third field.

name: run_lead_timer_updates
description: When three state fields are clear, makes two routine calls that update the lead timer display. The referenced text holds the lead timer label.

name: advance_deadline_by_fifteen
description: Calls two routines, then adds fifteen to a timer field. The referenced text holds headings for breakdown, centering and lap times.

name: run_update_loop_until_event
description: Toggles a flag word, then loops running update routines and a periodic counter until a status value is set, with an early exit when a state byte matches. It sits in a gap between code sections.

name: copy_entry_words_to_table
description: Walks the linked list of entries for up to six entries, copying each entry's first word into a table row chosen by a counter and adding a stored offset to the entry's field. It then increments the counter.

name: update_frame_motion_state
description: Updates per-frame motion: it adjusts a rotation value from status bits, applies stored rates to the position fields with fixed-point scaling and copies the results into display fields. It also checks a timer that triggers further routines.

name: update_object_position_when_active
description: When an object's active field is set, updates its position with wrap-around. It then computes a value from tables indexed by the object's index, compares it with a threshold and applies velocity and scaling updates. It sits in a gap between code sections.

name: update_angle_with_wrap
description: Adds a stored offset to an input angle, wraps the result into a 360-unit range and stores it with its paired value. It then updates scaled position and velocity fields from tables and checks a timer before calling a routine. It sits in a gap between code sections.

name: update_object_angle_and_position
description: Wraps an input angle into a 360-unit range and stores it with its paired value. It then updates the object's position and velocity fields from tables and checks its timer, calling routines when the object is active. It sits in a gap between code sections.

name: update_speed_and_audio_channels
description: Sets two audio channel volumes to forty or sixty depending on a flag, moves a speed value towards a target with a drag term and updates the output values used by later routines. The audio period is computed from the speed and a table entry in the following routine.

name: set_audio_periods_and_tick
description: Computes an audio period from a stored speed value and a table entry, clamps it between 299 and 810 and writes it to the period registers of two audio channels. Unless a stored value exceeds 256, it also counts a countdown down and, when it expires, runs routines and toggles a flag.

name: apply_damped_steering_adjustment
description: Clears two status words, then either moves a steering value towards a limit with damping and sets a state flag, or sets an indicator to one or two according to the status bits. It works on two value pairs using damping steps.

name: read_joystick_port_directions
description: Reads the joystick port data and the fire button line, combines the direction bits into a four-bit direction value and stores it in a status byte. The high bit is set when the fire line reads low, and the masked port value is returned.

name: update_record_positions_from_table
description: Loops over the object records while the race state is non-negative, interpolating each record's position, height and angle from a stored table. It checks each record against a list of threshold values and adjusts its distance field when one is passed, then calls routines to advance each record. The referenced text is a number label.

name: update_object_records_loop
description: Walks the object records, updating each record's velocity and timer from stored scale values and calling routines to start or stop each record's state. It sits in a gap between code sections.

name: count_record_passage_event
description: Returns zero when a record's timestamp is less than four hundred ticks old. Otherwise it increments the record's counter, sets its bit in a status word and, when a condition holds, updates the record's timing and runs routines. The referenced text is a qualifying label.

name: update_speed_penalty_state
description: Runs several conditional routine calls based on status flags, then reduces a counter by an amount derived from speed. It adds a bonus to two offsets when a stored value changes, and when a threshold of minus 1999 is crossed it calls routines and sets a flag.

name: advance_state_machine_stage
description: Advances a stage counter: it waits for a timer, runs routine calls at each stage and, when the counter reaches seven, clears several status words and copies the current time into every record.

name: run_state_transition_routines
description: When a state word is zero it calls a routine with a timer of 800 ticks. It then waits until a status word clears, calls a routine with the current state value and a fixed code, and restores a saved word.

name: refresh_lead_and_position_display
description: Toggles status flags when counters cross thresholds, calls routines to refresh the on-screen text for the lead and positions labels, and checks a deadline before updating record positions. The referenced text includes the lead, positions and warning labels.

name: forward_single_routine_result
description: Calls one routine and returns its result pair unchanged.

name: offset_fields_then_restore
description: Saves two fields, calls four routines, adds a fetched value minus twenty-four to each of two fields, makes two more routine calls, then restores the saved values.

name: handle_positive_result_flag
description: Calls one routine and returns its pair. When a flag is set and the high half is positive it makes one more routine call, choosing between two calls according to whether the value is below two.

name: start_timed_event_once
description: When a counter is zero, optionally calls a routine with code twelve, increments the counter, sets a timer five thousand ticks ahead and calls one more routine.

name: initialise_timed_event_state
description: Resets an event timer and two counters, then sets the event deadline from a stored value plus a routine value scaled by fixed factors. It also sets a flag when a stored field is nonzero.

name: reset_timed_event_fields
description: When a state word is positive it calls a routine with code thirteen. It then calls one more routine and resets two timer fields to minus one and a counter to minus fifteen.
